Không. Chủ trọ chỉ cần chia sẻ liên kết: No. Landlords simply share the private room link or enable Zalo reminders. Tenants open the link right in their mobile browser to inspect rent, meter readings, and scan the QR code to pay.

Roomie quản lý tiền cọc và quy trình trả: How does Roomie handle security deposits and move-out settlement?
Tiền cọc được theo dõi trên sổ cái riêng: Deposits are tracked in a dedicated ledger (collection, invoice deduction, or refund) and never mixed into rental revenue. At move-out, Roomie checks outstanding balances, records final meter readings, and revokes the old tenancy link.
Tính năng nhắc hóa đơn qua Zalo hoạt độn: How do Zalo invoice reminders work without spamming tenants?
Khi phát hành hóa đơn hoặc đến lịch hẹn: When an invoice is issued or on your monthly schedule, Roomie sends a Zalo message pointing to the tenant invoice link. Messages are strictly sent between 07:00 and 21:00 with built-in duplicate prevention and cooldowns.
Khi tôi thay đổi giá thuê hoặc đơn giá đ: If I change the room rent or utility rates, will previously issued invoices change?
Không. Mỗi hóa đơn khi phát hành đều lưu: No. Every issued invoice stores an immutable snapshot of the room rent, utility rates, occupant count, and meter readings for that period. Updating room rates for future months never alters historical issued invoices.

Chọn ngân hàng và nhập số tài khoản của: Select your bank and enter your account number. Roomie will automatically generate a VietQR code with the exact amount on every tenant invoice.
Vào phòng trống để thêm khách thuê, nhập: Check in tenants to vacant rooms, enter initial electricity/water readings, scan Citizen ID/Passport to print Rental Contract + CT01 form, and share the private invoice link.
Hàng tháng bạn chỉ cần bấm vào đây để nh: Each month, simply enter the new electricity/water readings here. The system automatically calculates the total, issues the invoice, and prepares payment reminders.
